MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The stainless wood screws felt useful alongside my recent nuts, bolts, and washers because they serve a related fastening purpose, although having only one size limits their usefulness.",
    "Practical hardware was a reasonable direction given my recent purchases of fasteners and hooks, but only the wood screws felt useful enough to choose now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My magnetic hooks help with storage and organization; sharing a magnetic material does not make a magnet fishing bundle useful to me.",
    "Wire connectors and heat shrink tubing require an electrical repair I have not indicated, so several similar wiring supplies all missed my current needs.",
    "The large glue refill, printer filament, and pressure gauge depend on specific projects or equipment I have no current need for.",
    "The SAE set screws were less relevant than they first appeared because my recent assortment was metric and I have no immediate use for those specialized screws."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in practical hardware seemed to be stretched into an interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "Shared words and materials, such as magnets or screws, seemed to matter more than whether the items serve the same purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases point toward fastening and organizing, which is more specific than a general interest in tools and repair supplies.",
    "Fastener dimensions, metric versus SAE sizing, and intended use affect whether a seemingly related item is actually useful.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear use, so a possible future wiring, printing, or woodworking project is not enough to interest me."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical hardware but often missed the fastening and organizing purposes that make it useful to me."
}
